name: gamedev-workflow
description: A Claude Code workflow for making Unity games alone or in a team: critical design partner, small playable slices, playtests by people, protected tuning, small project memory, safe shared repos.

plugins.name: gamedev-core
plugins.description: Shared skills every mode needs. Always install this one.

plugins.name: gamedev-jam
plugins.description: Game jam mode (1-3 weeks). Install together with gamedev-core.

plugins.name: gamedev-solo
plugins.description: Long-term solo project mode. Install together with gamedev-core.

plugins.name: gamedev-team
plugins.description: Team project in one shared repo, any size. Install together with gamedev-core.
